node.title: XR low-core u=0 loop-defect ratio router
node.statement: In every RowC rank-five P-B cell with u=0 and v>=1, deleting the v kernel loops removes at most v selected slopes and leaves a GRS_4 extension family on N=R+4 points. For every reused four-core T, the exact interpolation ratio has at most v-1 denominator-zero points per incident agreement set, so each slope contributes at least h+1 points to a disjoint ratio fiber and the line population is at most floor(R/(h+1)). A multiplicity-sensitive peeling formula D_r=C(4+h+v,4)-floor((r-1)C(R+4,4)/(8n^3+1-v)) supplies the complete rich-core interface. This reaches but does not pay the residual v<=1,2,6 cells.
